about: Adoption and ecosystem wording that the public surfaces must not carry: the README, index.html, the site source (site/src/, site/motion/) and the built site.
scripts/check-drift.sh and scripts/check-site.py both read this file; edit it here only.

Each phrase is a case-insensitive regular expression. A space in a phrase matches any run of 'gap' (whitespace and line breaks,  , inline tags, Markdown emphasis), so a soft wrap, imported from or what we took still match.
A match must start and end at a word edge: no letter or digit beside it, and a lone _ counts as an edge (Markdown emphasis) while a class like x__y does not.
